component: EWS References header fetch and database handoff

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing requests message:References and forwards the optional EWS string through MessageHeaders into SetReferences. It uses References alone; an early In-Reply-To concatenation plan was not applied, and a later participant explicitly warned that concatenation can repeat the parent ID. The server-synthesizes-References rationale remains attributed, not a universal Exchange guarantee. Fixed active sync now requests the same property, maps it into a HeaderBlock and passes that block to its creation listener. The relocated shared optional adapter/setter is separate; a bounded Rust source search found no outside populate_from_message_headers call. Keep active consumers distinct from retained helper code. No EWS sync, threading, build or test ran.
title: Keep EWS References mapping separate from the superseded In-Reply-To concatenation plan
